focuses.desc:
China has surrendered. Japan holds the coast, Wang Jingwei's Reorganized National Government (RNG) holds the interior for Tokyo, and the rump Nationalist government - the Northwestern Army - holds the far northwest. The Communists are left with the poor loess hills around Yan'an, blockaded on every side. There is no help from Moscow: the Soviet Union is gone, and Stalin sits in Irkutsk with only his most loyal men.

The Party's answer is the one it has always had: survive, organise, and let the enemy's own rule recruit for it.

HOW PRC GETS THIS TREE (to build): when Japan's dictated peace fires (tools/gen_jap_china_peace.py) and PRC still exists, it loads this tree (wif_prc_focus) in place of the vanilla one. PRC is not re-formed if it was destroyed.

LENGTH: about 8 years, ending around 1950-52 - in step with the RNG tree. The last focus, A Single Spark, waits for RNG's collapse (wif_rng_collapse_begun) or 1951. The real crisis comes in a later addition; this tree is the build-up.

STARTING SPIRITS (proposed):
- After the Surrender: -10% stability, -10% war support. Removed by The Party Survives.
- The Blockade (3 tiers): Japan and RNG to the east, the Northwestern Army to the west. Tier 3: -30% trade, +10% consumer goods, -20% construction speed. Economy focuses lower it a tier; Break the Blockade removes it.
- No Help from Moscow: -10% research speed, no lend-lease from anyone. Eased by the foreign branch.

FUNDING THE RESISTANCE IN RNG (decisions, to build - the PRC side of the RNG tree's Three Resistances):
  Fund the Communist Guerrillas:
    Send Cadres South - 25 political power: Communist Guerrillas +3.
    Send Rifles - 1000 infantry equipment: +4.
    Guerrilla Instructors - 50 political power: their operations cost 10% less strength for 180 days.
    Name the Target - 35 political power: choose the Communists' next operation instead of letting them plan.
  Fund the Liberation League:
    Fund the League - 25 political power: Liberation League +3, League Allegiance +10.
    Send Organisers to the Factories - 50 political power: Strike in the Factories needs 10 less strength for 180 days, Allegiance +5.
  Each funding decision raises Japan's suspicion (opinion -5, stacking). At -50 Japan may launch a Punitive Expedition against Yan'an (a Japanese decision).

LEAGUE ALLEGIANCE (new, shared with the Northwestern Army): -100 (Nationalist) to +100 (Communist), starts at 0. PRC funding pushes it up, the Northwestern Army's funding pushes it down. When the League liberates a district: at +50 or more it is a Communist-led liberated area that PRC can bring into the Border Region; at -50 or less it answers to the Northwestern Army; in between it stands alone. The later crisis will read it.

THE UNDERGROUND RAILWAY: once built, every Free a Labour Column and Break Open a Labour Camp by the Communists or a pro-Communist League sends people north: PRC +1000 / +3000 manpower.
